s: Ubo b' seipim: yesh meqomot nohagin shelleachar hattepilla meriin terua gedola belo teqia, kede learbeb et hassatan, shello yeqatreg achar hattepilla sheholekim veokelim veshotim usemechim lomar sheenam yereim meemat yom haddin. Veyesh meqomot nohagim lachazor velitqoa sheloshim qolot, lepi shechosheshin shemma miqtzat hatztzibbur lo shameu kol hatteqiot karauy vekahogen veyetzeu bishmiat teqiot ellu. Veyesh nohagin litqoa mea qolot, dehaynu shettoqein achar hattepilla lehashlim mea qolot im hatteqiot shel meyushshab veshel meummad:

Abal leachar shekkebar gameru kol minyan teqiot ellu — en litqoa od bechinnam, shehare hatteqia hi asura beyom tob middibre soperim, velo hittiruhu ella letzorek kegon kede laasot nachat ruach lannashim litqoa lahen, veken hannohagin litqoa achar hattepilla kevan shehen tzerikin litqia zo mittaam hayyadua lahem hittiru lahem chakamim, lepi sheen bitqiat shopar shebut gamur ella ubdin dechol, abal litqoa bechinnam hu zilzul yom tob. Vaapillu mi sheyyitqa beyom sheni — asur lo lehitlammed bayyom harishon, shehare anu yodein ubeqiin biqbiat hachodesh, veanu yodein sheharishon qodesh vehashsheni chol, venimtza toqea teqiot sheenam tzerikim lo beyom tob ella bechol. Veen tzarik lomar sheen lehotzi et hashshopar lirshut harabbim litqoa teqia sheeno tzarik lo hayyom, shehare hu motzi mereshut lirshut shello letzorek yom tob. Abal muttar lomar leqatan sheyyitqa kede sheyyitlammed, ben shehiggia lechinnuk ben shello higgia lechinnuk, umuttar lo litqoa kol hayyom apillu leachar sheyyishma hatteqiot bebet hakkeneset, lepi shemmitzva al haggedolim lelammed et haqqetannim ulechannekam bemitzvot:
